damped_resonance.note: excluded from dB spectral SR-parity; onset/peak/decay gate per §13.2
damped_resonance.sample: for t < onset: 0; else peak_amplitude * exp(-(t-onset)/tau_s) * sin(2*pi*center_hz*(t-onset) + phase_at_onset_rad)

decorrelated.draw_order: render left with left seed (k=0..511), then right with right seed (k=0..511); identical freqs/amplitudes as mono pseudo_noise

active_interval.rationale: global asset remains duration_s=2; chirp occupies only [t_start, t_end] inside the common useful window so every SWEEP_CHECKPOINT_HZ crossing is reachable within match radius H/fs_c

log_sweep.amplitude_formula: 10**(-24/20) preregistered peak amplitude (peak = −24 dBFS; not RMS-of-sine * sqrt(2))

checkpoint_reachability.rule: forall f in checkpoint_hz: common_useful_start <= t_cross(f) <= common_useful_end AND forall fs in gate_sample_rates: nearest_useful_frame_distance(t_cross, fs) <= H/fs_c

log_sweep.instantaneous_freq_hz: for t in [t_start, t_end]: f(t) = f_start * (f_end/f_start)**u with u=(t-t_start)/T_active, T_active=t_end-t_start; outside active interval: undefined (sample=0)
log_sweep.phase_integral_rad: for t in [t_start, t_end]: phi(t) = 2*pi * f_start * T_active / ln(f_end/f_start) * ((f_end/f_start)**u - 1), u=(t-t_start)/T_active; phi(t_start)=0
log_sweep.sample: for t in [t_start, t_end]: A * sin(phi(t)); else 0; A=amplitude_peak

multitone.amplitude_formula: 10**(-24/20) * sqrt(2/N) with N=len(frequencies_hz); equal-power packaging aligned with §13 pseudo-noise
multitone.waveform: sum_k A * sin(2*pi*f_k*t + phi_k) in float64; k ascending in frequencies_hz order

pseudo_noise.phase_rule: rng = Generator(PCG64(31051986)); phase[k] = 2*pi*rng.random() for k=0..511 ascending
pseudo_noise.waveform: sum_{k=0..511} A * sin(2*pi*freq[k]*t + phase[k]) in float64; cast float32; no renormalize

transient_burst.note: excluded from dB spectral SR-parity; onset/peak/decay gate per §13.2
transient_burst.sample: for t < onset: 0; else peak_amplitude * exp(-(t-onset)/tau_s)

ultrasonic_96k.waveform: sum_k A * sin(2*pi*f_k*t + phi_k) in float64; k ascending

envelope_authority: freeze-from-prose packaging of §13 fixture freedoms (amplitudes/phases/envelopes/sweep law/stereo/duration/numeric generation semantics); contract has no literal JSON key table for this artifact; NO REV7 — packaging only; does not implement audio generators (M3/T6 after CC+commit)

bound_check.rationale: conservative lab default: duration_s=2 > max(warm_up+coda)≈0.3428 s (lock rationals 18896/55125) so mode-(a) useful segment is long enough (~77 hops @ fs_c) for SR-parity multitone/noise; T_min=8H/fs_c is mode-(b) diagnostic only and must not define duration

numeric_generation.cast_policy: after full float64 render, cast each sample to IEEE754 binary32 round-to-nearest-even (language/numpy default float64→float32); no dither

file_format.non_finite_encoding: same WAV PCM float32 LE container; inject IEEE754 binary32 NaN/+Inf/-Inf bit patterns at pinned samples

numeric_generation.prng_draw_order: sequential rng.random() calls in ascending k; never reverse, never vector-size ambiguity vs loop
numeric_generation.render_policy: generate DIRECTLY at each of 44100/48000/96000; never resample one rate to another
numeric_generation.sum_order: ascending partial index k (or ascending frequency list order); accumulate in float64 before cast
